answer: Make new identities borrow trust along a trellis of vouching edges: each sponsor stakes part of its own balance on an invitee, and if the invitee is later slashed for fraud, the penalty ripples back up the chain to every voucher. A sybil farm then needs real collateral per fake node, and one exposed fake taints its whole cluster. Explorers can color these flagged subgraphs violet, so graders discount votes coming from them.
